title: fritillaria coccinea
intro: Fritillaria coccinea, commonly known as the red lilyturf or orange fritillary, is a type of flowering plant in the lily family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in Chinese medicine, for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria coccinea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which exhibit a range of pharmacological activities, including expectorant, antitussive, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's bioactive constituents also include compounds like veratridine, homofranciscine, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
